high_level_description: The image shows a Playbill for the Broadway show "Stranger Things: The First Shadow" at the Marquis Theatre in New York City. The Playbill is predominantly black with bold red and white text. At the top, it reads "PLAYBILL" in large, black letters on a yellow background, followed by "MARQUIS THEATRE" in smaller black text below. The title of the show, "STRANGER THINGS," is prominently displayed in large, red, bold letters, with a horizontal red line above and below the word "THINGS." Below the title, the subtitle "THE FIRST SHADOW" appears
